selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: /srv/drop created with sticky bit, world-writable, root-owned
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed /srv/drop did not exist beforehand, then created it and verified mode 1777 (drwxrwxrwt) owned by root:root

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: users can write shared files but cannot remove/overwrite others' files
selected_evidence.summary: Created two test users; both wrote files into /srv/drop successfully; dropuser2's attempt to rm or truncate dropuser1's file failed with Operation not permitted / Permission denied, proving sticky-bit restricted deletion

selected_evidence.requirement: Cleanup of test artifacts before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Removed test files and test users, confirmed /srv/drop remained at 1777 root:root

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity for node1

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of /srv/drop configuration and sticky-bit behavior
